name: Sex Change
overview: Scripture affirms that God created humanity distinctly as male and female, made in His own image with purposeful design and blessing to multiply and steward the earth (Genesis 1:27-28). The union of man and woman in marriage is established as a divine ordinance, reflecting the intended order of gender and relationship (Genesis 2:24). The Bible clearly prohibits behaviors that confuse or contradict this created distinction, including cross-dressing and sexual relations outside the God-ordained male-female framework (Leviticus 18:22; Deuteronomy 22:5). Additionally, Psalm 139:13 emphasizes God's intimate involvement in forming each person in the womb, underscoring the sanctity and intentionality of God's design for gender.
